title: Little Boy Riding Tricycle in Sunny Yard, 1950 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot of everyday mid-century American childhood taken in May 1950. A young boy smiles as he pedals his tricycle across a paved yard or driveway on a bright, sunny afternoon. He is dressed in a striped long-sleeve shirt and dark trousers with suspenders. In the background, fresh laundry hangs on a clothesline, casting whimsical shadows across the ground.
